findings.claim: KLA 10-K FY2026 稱遵循包含反壟斷在內之各項法規，目前對資本支出、財務狀況、營運結果或競爭地位無重大影響。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2026 Item 1 Business - Government Regulations
findings.excerpt: Compliance with these laws and regulations does not presently have a material effect on our capital expenditures, financial condition, results of operations or competitive position.

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因子提到美國商務部依 Section 232 對半導體及半導體製造設備進口展開國安調查，結果未知，可能帶來額外關稅與貿易限制。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2026 Item 1A Risk Factors
findings.excerpt: The scope of the investigations includes semiconductors, semiconductor manufacturing equipment and their derivative products, including semiconductor substrates and bare wafers, legacy chips, leading-edge chips, microelectronics and other components. While the results of the investigations are currently unknown, they may result in additional tariffs and trade restrictions, which may adversely impact our business.

findings.claim: 三次搜尋均未找到 2026 年針對 KLA 的 DOJ／FTC／歐盟反壟斷調查或拆分報導；僅見 2016 年與 Lam 合併因反壟斷疑慮取消等舊事。
findings.source: WebSearch 結果摘要（Law360 'Lam Research, KLA-Tencor Scrap $10B Merger Deal'）

note: Item 3 Legal Proceedings 摘錄只有標題，未能據以斷言無訴訟。出口管制（BIS）屬另軸，不在此列。
